elements.name: q1
elements.title: What is a common equivalent alternative for a prerecorded audio-only interview?
choices: A transcript including meaningful dialogue and sounds
A silent video without equivalent information

elements.name: q2
elements.title: Which alternative can convey the content of a silent prerecorded demonstration?
choices: An equivalent text alternative or an equivalent audio track
A louder soundtrack unrelated to the demonstration

elements.name: q3
elements.title: A recorded tutorial combines narration and moving visuals. How is it classified?

answer_key.q1: A transcript including meaningful dialogue and sounds
answer_key.q2: An equivalent text alternative or an equivalent audio track

explanations.q1: A transcript can communicate the audio information in text.
explanations.q2: The criterion permits an alternative for time-based media or an audio track for prerecorded video-only.
explanations.q3: Synchronized audio and video have additional applicable criteria.
